|game_text=Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further{{!}}This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time]] on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force Drains or 'swing' more than once per battle. [[Cloud City Occupation]] is canceled.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[He's No Jedi]] (version 2 of 4). The image here is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-35-Hes_No_Jedi-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]; no published image shows this text). The current text is [[He's No Jedi (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes. How these versions came about (Holotable data, the PC website card list, the Master List and the PC card images) is told in [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]].
* '''Original''' ([[He's No Jedi]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force drains. Cloud City Occupation is canceled.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “35” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) added “or 'swing' more than once per battle” (and printed “Force Drains” with a capital D): “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force Drains or 'swing' more than once per battle. Cloud City Occupation is canceled.”.<ref name="cl-1261_35-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The swing clause is already in the Players Committee's own Holotable card data of 29 May 2010, so this text existed by that date (card data, not a printed or announced source)<ref name="cdf-20100529-dark">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (darkside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>. The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[He's No Jedi (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-D-hesnojedi-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force drains. Cloud City Occupation is canceled.” '''What changed:''' “or 'swing' more than once per battle” is gone again, and “Force drains” has a small d again. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual6-Dark) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual6-Dark">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034706/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual6-Dark/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “35” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[He's No Jedi (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Dark Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on table with 5 cards from outside your deck face down under here. Twice per game, may play a Defensive Shield from here (as if from hand). If This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time on table, for remainder of game lightsabers may not add to Force drains. Cloud City Occupation is canceled.” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “35”). GEMP's current card plays this text: lightsabers may again 'swing' more than once per battle (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
